summary: The root QRF relates to mixing with others, especially those who are diseased. It signifies being near to someone or a place infected with illness, particularly pestilence or epidemic disease.
lane: قَرَفٌ ذ The mixing with others; [and particularly with others who are diseased or the like ]; a subst. from : (K:) the being near to [ a person, or persons, or a place, infected with ] disease: (S, TA:) the being near to pestilence, or epidemic disease. (T in art. تلف .) See تَلَفٌ .

headwords.def: قَارَفَهُ He was, or became, near to it; meaning some base thing, or the like. (TA.) See قَرَفٌ.

قَرَفٌ The mixing with others; [and particularly with others who are diseased or the like ]; a subst. from: (K:) the being near to [ a person, or persons, or a place, infected with ] disease: (S, TA:) the being near to pestilence, or epidemic disease. (T in art. تلف.) See تَلَفٌ.
أَعْرَضَتِ القِرْفَةُ signifies إِتَّسَعَتْ: (TA, art. عرض:) and اِتَّسَعَتْ قِرْفَتُهُ signifies كَثُرَ مَنْ يَتَّهِمُهُ. (TA, art. لبس.) See voce عَرُضَ.
مَقْرِفٌ A place of paring off: see an ex. voce صَمْغٌ.

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
